title: PILOT-Bench: A Benchmark for Legal Reasoning in the Patent Domain with IRAC-Aligned Classification Tasks

model.params_source: paper Appendix F (gpt-o3-2025-04-16); reasoning effort and decoding not stated (temperature/top_p not configurable for o3, placeholders)

task.subset_rule: all cases (15,482 evaluated; Table 2(a) Split (Base) n = 15,481), input = appellant arguments + examiner findings with the PTAB opinion excluded
task.approximation: The Issue Type prompt (Appendix D.3, Figure 8) is an image and is not recoverable from the text.

items.config_or_split: opinion_split data (fields per card: file_name, appellant_arguments, examiner_findings, ptab_opinion, issue_type, board_rulings, subdecision)
items.license: cc-by-4.0 (with a stated no-legal-advice use restriction)

prompt.user_template: NOT IN TEXT: the Issue Type prompt is Appendix D.3 Figure 8 (image); the extraction only carries the Figure 6 opinion-split skeleton. Structure per Sec. 5.1 / Appendix F.1: task instruction + label dictionary (Table 14) + JSON-only output rule + <APPELLANT ARGUMENTS>{appellant_arguments}</APPELLANT ARGUMENTS> <EXAMINER FINDINGS>{examiner_findings}</EXAMINER FINDINGS>
prompt.source_location: Appendix D.3 (Figure 8: Issue Type prompt); Tables 14-19 (label dictionaries)
prompt.verbatim: partial (prompt text not recoverable from the extracted text)

output.postprocess: normalize per Appendix F.1 (dedupe, strip subsection suffixes such as 103(a) -> 103)

metric.name: micro_f1
metric.definition: micro-F1 over multi-label Issue Type predictions vs gold label sets across all cases
metric.original_location: Table 2(a), block Split (Base), row GPT-o3, column Micro-F1

open_points: no hook: the Issue Type prompt is Figure 8 (an image) and the code release reads it from data/prompt/decision_predict/{system.txt, issue_type.txt}, a folder absent from github.com/TeamLab/pilot-bench (it may sit inside the 55 MB HF tarball pilot-bench.tar.gz - not verified).

no hook: the paper's calls used OpenAI function calling (predict_issue_type, config/issue_predict.json 'gpt-o' block) to force a JSON list; the runner's request body cannot carry functions/function_call and analyze() reads only message.content.
a full run is ~$900 on o3; a seeded subsample (e.g. 2,000 cases) and the o3 reasoning effort (not stated) are human decisions.
notes: HF tarball is 55 MB (above the download limit), so fields are taken from the dataset card. Macro-F1 0.6639 and Exact Match 0.5955 are the other cells of the row.
